description: Contributed in a development squad to build the MVP of I-Car, a mobile fleet management application (tracking, car policy, maintenance).
Engineered a secure peer-to-peer communication flow between employees to coordinate vehicle handovers with verifiable data authenticity.
Delivered and validated a fully functional MVP, successfully proving the core product workflows to the client.
Development of TPKAIZEN, a dashboard enabling SMEs to pilot and monitor n8n automations transparently and intuitively.
Conception and development of the backend API (Node.js, Fastify) and contribution to the monitoring interface (Ember.js).
Integration of AI into n8n automations to streamline workflow processes.
Implementation of the Human-in-the-Loop mechanism (AI proposes, human validates): ensuring AI is safely adopted by non-technical teams with human oversight at each critical step.
Observational internship within a Java development team, discovering software project operations in real-world conditions.
Scrum Methodology: participated as an observer in key ceremonies (daily, sprint planning, review, retrospective) and grasped the roles across the squad.
Java Project Structure: explored project architecture, workload distribution, and collaborative team best practices.
Team Culture: observed developer collaboration, communication, and progress tracking, providing a concrete foundation for the agile workflows I apply in my projects today.
Lesson Preparation and Delivery: structured educational content, progressive learning paths, and continuous adaptation to student skill levels.
Knowledge Simplification: communicated concepts clearly and accessibly to learners with diverse backgrounds.
Group Facilitation: captured engagement, navigated classroom unpredictability, and encouraged everyone to actively participate.
Communication: provided clear, supportive, and constructive feedback to encourage growth.
Key Takeaways for Software Engineering: ability to explain complex technical concepts simply, adapt communication to diverse stakeholders, and leverage fluent English daily in tech.
